learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected None and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Added 20 g: all dissolved, no crystals. Filled to 50 g: 36 dissolved and 14 crystals. Stirred twice; totals stayed fixed. Empty reset all totals to zero; refilled to 50 g with same 36/14 result.
observations.reveal: Corrected to about 14 g, referenced two stirring rounds, distinguished faster dissolving from increased capacity, explained equal ion exchange at saturation and limited 36 g value to 20 C.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Liquid contained two colors of ions, bottom crystal row and opposing arrows labeled as many each way. Totals, controls and explanation were legible.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.

interaction.evidence: 20 all dissolved; 50 leaves 14 despite two stirs.

payoff.evidence: Ions leave and return equally despite constant pile.
